verdict.rationale: Xero exposes ledger data via API/SDK and an official MCP server (contacts, chart of accounts, invoices) that could let an external agent build anomaly/duplicate monitoring, and JAX automates transaction matching during reconciliation, but there is no evidence of a built-in feature that actively flags spend anomalies or duplicate transactions before close. missing for 10: native anomaly-detection/duplicate-flagging capability, audit-close workflow integration, evidence of agents actually performing this monitoring in practice.
